text.description_html:
Acorn PMH-C-01, Tacitus Stainless Steel Cabinet Knob

Made of solid stainless steel, this egg shaped cabinet knob is a simple yet elegant way to add a modern accent to any home. The Tacitus Brushed Stainless Steel Cabinet Knob is sure to blend in seamlessly with any decor. It has a brushed stainless steel finish and comes packaged with all the necessary installation hardware.

Also Available Matching Tacitus Cabinet Knob

Specifications of the Tacitus Brushed Stainless Steel Cabinet Knob:

  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Height: 15/16"
  • Width: 1-25/64"
  • Projection: 1-3/8"
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold individually.
